name: Conveyor Run
design_intent:
CONVEYOR RUN — THE SCRAPWORKS tier-2 MOVING-PLATFORM stage (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 §Scrapworks row 11; the scrap sibling of the_convoy). A dusk scrap line over one full-width void: two static end YARDS (A left / B right) and a narrow static CENTRE island, bridged by TWO drifting CART decks (moving_platform vehicles) that ferry riders across the chasm. A spring THRONE hovers over the centre. The carts are RIDABLE FOOTING (they carry a standing rider), NOT hazards — the void is the killer. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%).

SYMMETRY: strictly mirror-symmetric about x=2900. Yards A and B are identical; carts L and R are mirror images with identical amp/period; the centre island + throne sit on the axis. No side is a free kill.

GEOMETRY (symmetric about x=2900): A x0..900 top1080 (trampoline, center 450) / CENTRE island x2740..3060 top1080 (trampoline, w320, center 2900) / B x4900..5800 top1080 (trampoline, center 5350). CART L center (1820,980) and CART R center (3980,980), both axis_deg 0, amplitude 200, w380 h48, period_s 4.6, dwell_frac 0.14 (deterministic phase clock with an end dwell = a beat to hop on/off). ONE spring THRONE x2720..3080 top560 over the centre island (520px climb). Bounds -560..6360 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (yard outer edges >= 560px inside the side blast; 670px recovery sky). VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering. Dusk-gold open_sky (clouds on, glow) = a twilight scrap line.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; ~395px trampoline drift / ~527 max spring drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses ~530px in <0.9s @ ~22 fuel; NO floor springs so 395 is the actual max floor bounce reach). Cart decks are w380 (half-width 190) on a bounded oscillation; every ride-surface gap at CLOSEST approach exceeds a bounce's reach:
- GAP A->CART L: A right edge x900 to CART L left edge at closest (1820-200-190=1430) = 530px over void. > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY (+ TIME the drift).
- GAP CART L->CENTRE: CART L right edge at closest (1820+200+190=2210) to CENTRE left edge (2740) = 530px over void. > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- GAP CENTRE->CART R: CENTRE right (3060) to CART R left at closest (3980-200-190=3590) = 530px over void. > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- GAP CART R->B: CART R right at closest (3980+200+190=4370) to B left edge (4900) = 530px over void. > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the spring THRONE (top560): 520px above the centre island (1080); trampoline apex 270 reaches only y810 (270px short). JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- Every crossing (530px at closest approach) exceeds a spring bounce's 527px reach and there is NO floor spring, so NO route across exists without the jetpack; the carts move the ride surfaces on a readable clock but never close a gap below the flight-required threshold. GI-2 (no-strand): carts oscillate on FIXED bounded paths, static A/B/centre anchor the ends -> no player stranded, no silent pin (open sky above the void). Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: deck/island bottoms (~1156-1208) to the bottom blast line (1878) = ~670-720px of open sky (>= 650) -> a fuelled knock-off boosts back. Verb: FLY.

SIGNATURE: the scrap conveyor — ride the carts and boost between them, cross ONLY on the jetpack, a moving-footing take on the flight-required loop.
